CodeQL query that builds Mermaid flowchart output for Firedancer topology tiles and links.

# Purpose
This CodeQL query file extracts topology information from C source files in `src/app/firedancer/topology.c` and `src/disco/net/fd_net_tile_topo.c`. It finds tile creation calls, input links, and output links, then builds a graph model of tiles and links while ignoring the `sock` alternative. The file can format the result as JSON or as Mermaid flowchart text, and the final `select` returns the Mermaid output for visualization.
